findings.title: phase3_engine.py returns a constant NOT-CLOSED verdict independent of measured state
findings.evidence: 00-MASTER/UAKOS-CLOSURE-002/phase3_engine.py assigns repository_status the literal "NOT-CLOSED" and --gate exits 1 unconditionally. Measured this session: unhomed concepts = 0, planned = 0/0, classes = 0, waves = 0, yet the gate still exited 1. A gate with no reachable PASS state carries no evidentiary value.
findings.note: DISCHARGED by WP-UCCEP-001 / OA-5. 00-MASTER/UAKOS-CLOSURE-002/phase3_engine.py no longer asserts a constant: repository_status IS measured from the located PHASE-002 closure determination (closure.json) and cross-checked against its blocking-gap count, so a CLOSED carrying gaps is itself refused; the three success criteria that were literal True (dependency-chain acyclicity, projected closure path, planning-only) are each measured — acyclicity by wave-monotonicity over the declared class chain plus a termination walk, and planning-only by a write-scope guard over the paths the engine actually wrote.
